versions.short: The resolution would set the rules for House floor debate on six separate measures: a defense authorization bill for fiscal year 2027 covering military activities, military construction, and Department of Energy defense work, along with military personnel strengths; a bill to reauthorize demonstration authority for the Social Security disability insurance program; a concurrent budget resolution setting budget levels for fiscal year 2027 and through fiscal year 2036; a bill to restrict stock holdings for Members of Congress and their spouses and dependents; a bill to make improvements to federal banking laws; and a bill providing continuing appropriations for fiscal year 2027.
